summary: JIADE Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting that Nasdaq has lifted the trading halt on its Class A ordinary shares, effective July 31, 2026, after the company responded to information requests under Listing Rule 5250(a). The inquiries covered recent trading activity, shelf takedown offerings, share consolidations, and prior financings. The company states it has no undisclosed material information. This is a regulatory disclosure regarding trading resumption, not a special situation corporate action.
